notes:
Detection: Instapage emits NO <meta name="generator"> (verified none in the raw HTML of injurylaw.pagedemo.co) and has NO "Made with Instapage" badge (verified absent), so URL + asset-domain + JS-global fingerprinting is required. Default hosting is a subdomain of pagedemo.co; that is the only case where the URL itself is a giveaway (detectUrlRegex \.pagedemo\.co). Most production sites run on the customer's own custom domain (CNAME to secure.pageserve.co), where the URL reveals nothing — rely on the asset/analytics signatures below, verified on 3 independent live sites (injurylaw.pagedemo.co, solutions.docbyte.com, www.linktek.com).

Verified cross-site signatures: (a) assets on *.fastcdn.co — images from v.fastcdn.co/u/<accountHash>/... (confirmed), CSS/JS bundles from c.fastcdn.co with filename pageserver.page2.es5.<hash>.bundle.js (confirmed verbatim: pageserver.page2.es5.ef023caa4c1542c75018.bundle.js on linktek), form-related host d.fastcdn.co (present in pagedemo HTML); (b) CloudFront distribution d3mwhxgzltpnyp.cloudfront.net serving a local-storage helper iframe (confirmed as a frame request on 2 sites); (c) beacon traffic to anthill.instapage.com (confirmed on all 3); (d) metrics/heatmap hosts cdn.instapagemetrics.com and heatmap-events-collector.instapage.com (present in pagedemo raw HTML; also ec.instapagemetrics.com) plus heatmap.services (confirmed lib.js on docbyte); (e) inline JS globals instapageSp and _instapageSnowplow (confirmed present in raw HTML). Cookies instapage-variant-<pageId>/instapage-visit-<pageId> plausible (urlscan flags Instapage variant tracking cookies).

Render strategy: full page content is present in the raw server HTML (122KB fetched from pagedemo) — content extraction works from a plain fetch. Treated as ssr-static; no headless hydration needed.

Anti-bot: none imposed by Instapage by default; no Cloudflare/CAPTCHA on published pages. Caveats: (1) pagedemo.co adds noindex,nofollow and rate-limits per IP — throttle; (2) some custom-domain customers front with their own Cloudflare — confirmed www.linktek.com returns Wappalyzer CloudFlare — so expect occasional customer-side WAF unrelated to Instapage. Mirror asset mapping: rewrite v.fastcdn.co (images), c.fastcdn.co (CSS/JS bundles), d3mwhxgzltpnyp.cloudfront.net helper; drop anthill.instapage.com, cdn.instapagemetrics.com, heatmap-events-collector.instapage.com, heatmap.services and the d.fastcdn.co form endpoint.
